episodes.title: Girl Meets World
episodes.summary: When Maya leads a rebellion in class, Riley joins in to try to be like her - much to her father, Cory's, dismay.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Boy
episodes.summary: In an attempt to get the students in his class to stop texting and communicate in person, Cory gives them a homework assignment that teaches them how to communicate face to face, ultimately sparking a real connection between Riley and Lucas.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Sneak Attack
episodes.summary: Riley becomes jealous when another girl flirts with Lucas, so she enlists Maya and Farkle's help to learn how to flirt too.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Father
episodes.summary: Cory struggles with Riley growing up when he learns she'd rather go to the school dance then participate in their yearly tradition of riding the Coney Island roller coaster. Simultaneously, he is dealing with the outcome of giving Maya an "F."

episodes.title: Girl Meets the Truth
episodes.summary: After Cory teaches a lesson on truth, Riley and Maya struggle with whether or not it was right to lie to Farkle and tell him he's a good actor and if Maya should keep the locket she found, even though it doesn't belong to her.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Popular
episodes.summary: Riley is surprised when she gets invited to a party that doesn't include Maya. However, once she arrives, she soon learns it's a party filled with unpopular classmates.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Maya's Mother
episodes.summary: When Maya's artwork is featured at a school event, Riley sees it as an opportunity to help Maya mend her relationship with her mother. Meanwhile, Cory and Topanga get a surprise visit from their childhood friend Minkus.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Smackle
episodes.summary: When Smackle, a debate champion from another school who happens to have a crush on Farkle, realizes that he only sees her as an academic rival, she enlists Maya and Riley to give her a makeover.

episodes.title: Girl Meets 1961
episodes.summary: Cory gives the class a living-history assignment that takes the four friends back to New York City in 1961.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Crazy Hat
episodes.summary: Cory divides his class into two fake companies for a lesson, one driven by profits and the other by making people happy. Meanwhile, Riley and Maya encounter a lady in the subway who is quite different than they first perceive her to be.

episodes.title: Girl Meets World: Of Terror
episodes.summary: The kids face a trilogy of terror when Riley has a sleepover at Maya's with her Gammy Hart and pet ferret. Auggie confronts the monster under his bed, and Farkle tackles his most terrifying fear yet - playing softball.

episodes.title: Girl Meets the Forgotten
episodes.summary: When the kids are assigned a special lesson on appreciation, Riley and Maya are forced to work in the school cafeteria while Lucas and Farkle are assigned janitorial duty.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Flaws
episodes.summary: Classmate teases Farkle for being different and not fitting in with the crowd. Hurt and confused, he stops going to class until Riley, Maya and Lucas rally him to show their classmates how to respect each other's uniqueness and show compassion to those who need it, no matter who they are.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Friendship
episodes.summary: When Cory teaches his class about various forms of government, Lucas, Riley and Farkle decide to run against each other for 7th-grade class president.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Brother
episodes.summary: Cory and Topanga are going out to celebrate their anniversary and decide to let Riley babysit Auggie for the first time. She enlists Maya's help, which leads Auggie to rebel against the girls.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Home for the Holidays
episodes.summary: It's Christmas at the Matthews, and Cory's best friend, Shawn Hunter, Riley's grandparents, and Uncle Joshua are coming over for a holiday dinner. Meanwhile, Topanga works on executing the perfect meal to put her mother-in-law at ease while Shawn sees his likeness in Maya and forms a bond with her and Riley.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Game Night
episodes.summary: Riley invites her friends along to join the traditional Matthews' Family Game Night, and Maya is excited to learn Riley's Uncle Josh is joining as well.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Master Plan
episodes.summary: Maya is celebrating her 14th birthday with Riley and the Matthews but is struggling with the fact that her mom probably won't be able to join them. Meanwhile, Corey and Riley devise a plan to setup Maya's mom with Shawn when he pays a visit.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Farkle's Choice
episodes.summary: Farkle is nominated for an award and must choose who to take to the awards dinner - Riley or Maya. Meanwhile, Topanga forms a book club for Auggie and his friends.

episodes.title: Girl Meets First Date
episodes.summary: Season 1 ends with Lucas asking Cory's permission to go on a date with Riley. He agrees but insists that Maya and Farkle go with them. Auggie and Ava get "married".

episodes.title: Girl Meets Gravity
episodes.summary: Riley and Maya are anxious to begin eighth grade and have a new teacher, that isn't Riley's father. Meanwhile, Mrs. Svorski asks Topanga to take over at the bakery.

episodes.title: Girl Meets the New World
episodes.summary: Riley and Lucas's classmates are curious as to what's going on with their relationship, which ultimately confuses them more than ever before.

episodes.title: Girl Meets the Secret of Life
episodes.summary: A new student from Texas turns out to be an old friend of Lucas. But, the Lucas of the past isn't the Lucas who the friends have come to love.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Pluto
episodes.summary: Cory, Topanga, Shawn, Riley and Maya travel to Philadelphia to dig up a time capsule that Cory, Topanga and Shawn buried 15 years ago which prompts the kids decide to create and bury one of their own.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Mr. Squirrels
episodes.summary: When Riley and Maya get into a fight, Cory enlists the help of his brother, Eric, to be a mediator.

episodes.title: Girl Meets the Tell Tale Tot
episodes.summary: Riley tells a lie so she and Maya can attend a party and must deal with the guilt of sneaking around her parents.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Rules
episodes.summary: When the entire class gets detention, the class divides and chaos ensues. Meanwhile, Auggie's friend Ava attempts to be nicer when she thinks she's losing him to another girl.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Hurricane
episodes.summary: Someone from Shawn's past comes back into his life and the situation threatens his relationship with Maya.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Mr. Squirrels Goes to Washington
episodes.summary: Uncle Eric is recruited to run for the Senate, but learns it was only because they expected him to lose. Riley and her friends rally together to help his campaign.

episodes.title: Girl Meets the New Teacher
episodes.summary: Cory defends a new teacher who comes under fire from the principal for using non-traditional ways of learning to engage students.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Fish
episodes.summary: Riley is supposed to take the class fish home for the weekend, but it dies as soon as she gets it. Auggie suspects foul play.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Yearbook
episodes.summary: The kids aren't satisfied with what they've been voted "Most Likely" for in the school yearbook, and take matters into their own hands to change it.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Semi-Formal
episodes.summary: Riley is asked to the semi-formal dance by a classmate named Charlie and is torn whether to go with him or Lucas. Meanwhile, Cory's brother Eric is paid a visit from an old friend.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Creativity
episodes.summary: When art and music are threatened to be cut from school, the kids have to find a creative way to convince the school board to show their value.

episodes.title: Girl Meets I Am Farkle
episodes.summary: Riley, Maya and Lucas emphasize the beauty of being unique as they rally around their friend Farkle Minkus, who may be on the autism spectrum and is tested for Asperger's syndrome.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Cory and Topanga
episodes.summary: Riley realizes that her parents are positively impacting the world and she wonders how she's contributing.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Rileytown
episodes.summary: After Maya hurts Riley's feelings, the group learns that Riley is overly sensitive because another classmate is making fun of her. Riley's friends encourage her to like herself for who she is.

episodes.title: Girl Meets World: Of Terror 2
episodes.summary: Riley and Maya meet the Ghost of the Bay Window, a flapper girl from the 1920s, who makes people sing and dance.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Rah Rah
episodes.summary: Riley really wants to be a cheerleader; when the tryouts begin, she's determined to make the squad.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Texas: Part 1
episodes.summary: Lucas is entered into a bull-riding contest in his hometown; Riley, Maya and Farkle head to Texas with him to cheer him on.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Texas: Part 2
episodes.summary: Lucas, Riley and Maya try and figure out their feelings while they're all in Texas together.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Texas: Part 3
episodes.summary: Maya, Lucas and Riley try to move on after what happened in Texas.

episodes.title: Girl Meets the Forgiveness Project
episodes.summary: When the class receives an assignment about forgiveness, Maya writes to her father in an attempt to forgive him for leaving and Riley tries to let go of the fact that Auggie destroyed something important to her.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Belief
episodes.summary: Cory asks the kids to challenge one another's beliefs to see if it changes their perspectives.

episodes.title: Girl Meets the New Year
episodes.summary: Farkle tells Riley that she has until midnight on New Year's Eve to tell everyone how she really feels about Lucas.

episodes.title: Girl Meets STEM
episodes.summary: Riley is upset when the boys at school won't let her participate in a science experiment and attempts to become more involved.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Money
episodes.summary: When Farkle's dad makes a bad investment, Farkle becomes worried about what that might mean for his family.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Commonism
episodes.summary: Maya and Farkle are caught cheating on a test and have to face the school honor board, which includes Riley and Lucas as members. Meanwhile, Auggie tries to figure out what he wants to be when he grows up.

episodes.title: Girl Meets the Bay Window
episodes.summary: Riley decides to redecorate the bay window; Maya is offended and hurt that Riley would violate their sacred space.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Legacy
episodes.summary: With middle school graduation around the corner, Riley, Maya, Lucas and Farkle work together to determine what kind of legacy they want to leave at John Quincy Adams.

episodes.title: Girl Meets High School (1)
episodes.summary: Riley, Maya, Lucas and Farkle start their freshmen year and quickly learn their place as smaller fish in a much bigger lake.

episodes.title: Girl Meets High School (2)
episodes.summary: As the group continues to adjust to the rigors of high school, some decide to join sports teams while others participate in academic clubs.

episodes.title: Girls Meets Jexica
episodes.summary: Riley's worried that her new classmates don't like the real her so she invents and online alter-ego named Jexica; Cory and Topanga face Auggie's internet usage.

episodes.title: Girls Meets Permanent Record
episodes.summary: Riley finds out the hard way that getting a bad grade in high school will count toward her permanent record.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Triangle
episodes.summary: Maya's art teacher implies that her friendship with Riley could be affecting her artist's voice, thus kicking her identity crisis into full gear.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Upstate
episodes.summary: Maya and Riley travel upstate to help Maya find her true artistic voice, but neglect to tell Cory and Topanga where they've gone.

episodes.title: Girl Meets True Maya
episodes.summary: Maya wants to do something bad to balance out all the good she's done lately.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Ski Lodge (1)
episodes.summary: When Cory becomes the head of the Nature Club, the whole gang heads out on a trip to a familiar ski lodge

episodes.title: Girl Meets Ski Lodge (2)
episodes.summary: With the group's ski trip coming to an end, it is apparent that Lucas must finally choose between Maya and Riley.

episodes.title: Girl Meets I Do
episodes.summary: Maya has some concerns about Shawn and Katy's upcoming wedding.

episodes.title: Girl Meets the Real World
episodes.summary: Riley has trouble with her debate assignment when she must argue if people are naturally good or evil.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Bear
episodes.summary: Riley wakes to find her childhood teddy bear, Barry the Bear, missing and enlists the help of her family and friends to find him.

episodes.title: Girl Meets the Great Lady of New York
episodes.summary: Some students learn surprises about their diverse heritage during Cultural Week.

episodes.title: Girl Meets She Don't Like Me
episodes.summary: Riley tries to make new friends in high school but everyone acts less friendly than she expects. The students learn a new lesson in health class.

episodes.title: Girl Meets World: Of Terror 3
episodes.summary: Auggie narrates a scary Halloween story about what the world would be like if Maya and Riley had never met.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Her Monster
episodes.summary: Riley skips out on helping Topanga at the bakery to stay home and binge-watch her favorite TV show and Topanga is not pleased.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Hollyworld
episodes.summary: Maya schemes to sabotage another actress so that her mom will get a role in an upcoming movie.

episodes.title: Girl Meets a Christmas Maya
episodes.summary: As Christmas approaches, Riley gets excited to celebrate her favorite holiday, but for Maya, the holidays only bring back unhappy memories from her childhood.

episodes.title: World Meets Girl
episodes.summary: World Meets Girl will be an interactive episode, answering the questions of the audience. It is intended to be for the fans.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Sweet Sixteen
episodes.summary: The approach of Riley's 16th birthday causes the kids to contemplate the future and how their relationships will change in a few short years.

episodes.title: Girl Meets Goodbye
episodes.summary: When Topanga is given the opportunity to operate the London office for her law firm, she tries to think of the right choice for her family while Riley and her friends contemplate what could happen if she is forced to move to London.
